column1: # 1D inject sweep at the high-floor corner: slope=600, floor=95 fixed,
# --inject in {1,2,3,4,5}. At floor=95 the multiplicative transfer
# w = 0.6*(src_w-95) collapses below the inject threshold almost immediately,
# so the additive inject (sink gains +N per drained-source event) dominates
# the sink-weighting dynamics. This sweep measures how the additive step size
# N trades off: too small may under-drive escape from local minima, too large
# may over-inflate weights and thrash. inject=1 is the compiled default.
